title: Auto Collect Hay, Instant Mode, Needle Hunt
features:
AUTO DIG & FARMING

• Auto Dig Engine (Fast automated hay picking)

• Dig Target Modes (Spiral, Ring, Center, Random)

• Adjustable Dig Radius & Speed Multiplier

• Rainbow Hay Filter (Off, Priority, Only - 10x Value Strands)

• Teleport to Hay Pile

AUTO SELL SYSTEM

• Auto Sell (Visits sell station at custom hay threshold)

• Smart Dynamic Sell Station Detection

• Sell Now (Instant sell with auto-return to previous position)

• Teleport to Active Sell Station

GEMS & NEEDLE AUTOMATION

• Auto Collect Gems (Listens to gem spawn events + area scan)

• Auto Needle (Instant teleport + automatic hand-in upon reveal)

• Tool Selector (Hand, TNT, Pitchfork, Drone, Vacuum)

TOOL SHOP AUTOMATION

• Auto Buy Tools (Server-confirmed purchase with Cash & Gems)

• Visual Hotbar Unlock Spoof (Shows all tools on client)

• Manual Purchase Buttons (TNT, Pitchfork, Vacuum, Drone)

• Server Tool Ownership Status Monitor

CHAPTER 2: BASEMENT PUZZLE SOLVER

• Instant Solve All Puzzles (Solves all 4 puzzles & restores position)

• Auto Solve on Round / Join (Background monitor)

• Live Puzzle Status Dashboard (Tracks progress, code, & escape door)

• Individual Puzzle Solvers:

- Solve Levers (Pulls all 3 wall levers)

- Solve Picture Puzzle (Rotates all 16 tiles to 0°)

- Solve Color Pedestals (Counts visible gems & submits)

- Solve Number Keypad (Discovers poster code & submits to keypad)

• Basement Teleports (Levers, Picture Board, Pedestals, Keypad, Metal Door, Escape Trapdoor)

AUTOMATIC UPGRADES

• Auto Upgrade (Buys upgrades within max price budget)

• Buy All Enabled Now (One-click bulk upgrade purchase)

• Individual Upgrade Track Controls:

- Hand (Capacity, Hold Time, Dig Speed, Strand Grasp)

- TNT (Lucky Blast, Cooldown, Power)

- Pitchfork (Cooldown, Hold, Sweep)

- Drone (Speed, Grasp, Capacity)

- Vacuum (Power, Cooling, Runtime)

VISUALS & ESP

• Master ESP Switch

• Rainbow Hay ESP (Highlights 10x value strands)

• Needle ESP (Highlights revealed needle)

• Loose Gems ESP (Highlights spawned gems)

PLAYER & MOVEMENT

• WalkSpeed & JumpPower Sliders

• Infinite Jump

• Smooth Fly Mode (Camera vector controls)

• Noclip (Walk through walls)

• Anti-AFK (Engine level bypass)

• Fullbright
